brief:
Several pubs across Ireland have refused to screen a Nations League football match involving Israel, citing the conflict in Gaza. The boycott reflects broader protest sentiment in the country over Israel's military operations in the Palestinian territory.

Ireland's football federation faces mounting pressure as the controversy surrounding the upcoming games threatens to overshadow the sporting event. The dispute has drawn international attention to the country's stance on the Israel-Gaza conflict.
dek: Ireland has been thrust into the global spotlight over two controversial Nations League football games against Israel.
title: Irish pubs boycott Israeli football match over Gaza
